## Problem

What is missing or wrong, and who runs into it. Concrete examples help.

## Proposal

What you want to build or change, in a few sentences.

## Alternatives

Other ways to solve it and why this one is better.

## Fit with the ground rules

Check any that apply and explain below.

- [ ] Changes a contract in `packages/core/src/contracts/`
- [ ] Sends raw event text to the `synthesize` tier
- [ ] Adds a dependency to `@yrm/core`
- [ ] Could be an extension instead of a core change

## Needs an ADR?

Yes or no, and why.
